name: frontend-craft
description: Codezal-native frontend design plugin. Builds distinctive, production-grade UI that avoids generic AI aesthetics, with accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and a self-review rubric baked in. /ui builds from a brief, /redesign elevates existing UI, /design-review critiques against the rubric.

attribution.notice: Inspired by the Anthropic frontend-design plugin from the claude-code official plugins marketplace. Reworked and repackaged as a Codezal-native plugin.
